providers.description: Chat providers captured by the Chrome extension's AI chats module and accepted by the server: chatgpt, claude, gemini. Captures from a provider not listed are skipped.

userName.description: Name used for your own messages in transcripts and for your Person entity.

autoSyncMinutes.description: How often the Chrome module re-checks ChatGPT and Claude conversation lists while a tab of that site is open. 0 turns background sync off; captures still happen when you open a conversation, and Sync buttons still work.

fetchDelayMs.description: Pause between conversation fetches during a sync, to stay well under the sites' rate limits.

maxConversationsPerSync.description: Most changed conversations one sync job fetches; the next sync continues with the rest.

gapMinutes.description: A silence longer than this starts a new conversation window (one searchable source per window).

maxWindowChars.description: Maximum transcript characters per window; keep at or below 12000 so whole windows stay searchable. Long replies make windows hold fewer turns.

idleMinutes.description: The newest window of a conversation is indexed only after this much silence, so an ongoing chat is summarised once.

summarize.description: Summarise each window with the chat LLM; otherwise a heuristic summary is used.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for window summaries. Empty uses the default.

namespace.description: Namespace for AI chat sources and graph entities.
